messages.snippet: Join us for a CPD session on Practice Direction 57AD (Disclosure) - lessons from the first two years
messages.subject: Lunch & learn: PD57AD disclosure two years on (24 April)
messages.plaintextBody:
Join us for a CPD session on Practice Direction 57AD (Disclosure) - lessons from the first two years, common pitfalls with Disclosure Review Documents, and tips for proportionate Extended Disclosure. Thursday 24 April, 12:30-13:30, Boardroom 4. Sandwiches provided. 1 hour CPD.

RSVP to Knowledge & Learning.
